nodes.summary: For the `q`-state Potts model on a finite graph with `p = 1 - e^{-βJ} ∈ (0, 1)`, `μ_{β,J,q}(σ_x = σ_y) - 1/q = (1 - 1/q) φ_{p,q}(x ↔ y)`. The hypothesis `hp1` holds for every real `βJ` and `hq` follows from `[NeZero q]`; the only restriction is `hp`, i.e. `βJ > 0` (ferromagnetic). (Edwards–Sokal, Phys. Rev. D 38, 1988; Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Theorem 1.16.)
